type HasSymbol<T> = Extract<keyof T, symbol> extends never ? false : true;
const arrayHasSymbol: HasSymbol<number[]> = true;
const objectHasSymbol: HasSymbol<{ x: number }> = false;
const mapHasSymbol: HasSymbol<Map<string, number>> = true;
type IteratorKey = typeof Symbol.iterator;
type UnscopablesKey = typeof Symbol.unscopables;
type SymbolKeys = Extract<keyof number[], symbol>;
type ExtractedIterator = Extract<SymbolKeys, IteratorKey>;
type SameKey = [IteratorKey] extends [ExtractedIterator] ? true : false;
const sameKey: SameKey = true;
type Values = number[][keyof number[]];
type SymbolValues = number[][SymbolKeys];
const value: Values = {};
const flags: number[][UnscopablesKey] = {};
const symbolValue: SymbolValues = flags;
type ArrayIteration = number[][IteratorKey];
function checkIterator(next: ArrayIteration) {
  const item = next().next();
  if (!item.done) return item.value.toFixed(1);
}
const userKey = Symbol('user');
const custom = { [userKey]: 9 };
type UserKeys = Extract<keyof typeof custom, symbol>;
const sameUser: UserKeys = userKey;
console.log(arrayHasSymbol, objectHasSymbol, mapHasSymbol, sameKey, value, flags, typeof sameUser);
